records.public_claim_text: Foreword Since the turn of the century, the world has made huge strides against maternal mortality: a 40% reduction between 2000 and 2023.

records.public_claim_text: This report presents more good news: in 2023, for the first time, no countries fell into the extremely high maternal mortality category (defined as over 1000 maternal deaths per 100 000 live births).
